narrative.headline: Find California and U.S. open datasets and SEC EDGAR filings with clear provenance.
narrative.value_prop: Search either public-data catalog or both, inspect metadata and download selected resources. Direct EDGAR commands search filings and retrieve company submissions and financial facts; local snapshot tools support repeatable catalog research.
narrative.auth_narrative: California public reads need no key. Federal official v4 gateway uses a free api.data.gov key. Public DEMO_KEY is for initial exploration only: 30 requests per hour and 50 per day. Configure a personal key for automated use. SEC reads use SEC_USER_AGENT with your app name and contact email, and require no API key.

quickstart.comment: Check the command setup without network access.
Compare a bounded selection from both catalogs.
Find a company filing after setting SEC_USER_AGENT.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for repeatable discovery of California and U.S. catalog datasets, metadata inspection and explicitly selected downloads.
anti_triggers: Do not use for publishing, modifying or deleting government catalog records.
Do not assume catalog metadata is the underlying measurement data or a full copy of either catalog.

recipes.title: Inspect concise search results
recipes.command: government-data-pp-cli catalog find water --source both --limit 5 --agent --select results.title,results.source,results.id --demo
recipes.explanation: Keep only the fields needed to select records.
